datastream-derived copy at autonomous-computer/docs, recorded so the guard can
fail on anything NEW. This is a ratchet, not a mute button: an entry that stops
diverging fails the guard, so the file must shrink as the specs converge.
Do not add entries to silence a fresh divergence - fix the text instead.
